Synopsis:
    Jon Rahm is navigating personal and professional uncertainty heading into late 2026. He plans to play the Irish Open and BMW PGA Championship but has no firm schedule beyond that, pending the birth of his fourth child. LIV Golf faces potential bankruptcy as CEO Scott O'Neil pursues a "LIV 2.0" restructuring, leaving Rahm's contractual future — reportedly $100M+ remaining — unresolved. Rahm has retained DP World Tour membership and Ryder Cup eligibility but is noncommittal on a PGA Tour return, stating only "time will tell." Regional geopolitical tensions (Iran-Israel-US conflict) add further uncertainty to the DP World Tour's Abu Dhabi and Dubai season-ending events.
